claim.decision: Replace the previous Dots evaluator with this local filesystem workflow
claim.statement: The evaluator routes each request to the right branch, scales rigor to evidence maturity, preserves approval and isolation gates, and reports only supported conclusions.
limits: The suite establishes core workflow behavior, not performance across every host or model.
Visual usability requires separate human review of generated pages.

configurations.host: Codex or Claude with local filesystem access
tools: fresh subagent when execution is approved

graders.criterion: Judge each supplied observable criterion independently from the worker response and artifacts; keep evaluation-system failures inconclusive.

cases.name: Plan an evaluation for an unproven skill
cases.prompt: Use the evaluator to help me determine whether the skill in fixtures/unproven-skill reliably creates decision briefs. Inspect what evidence exists and move the work forward safely.
expected_outcomes: Classifies the skill as unproven
Creates a small discriminating draft plan and cases
Requests approval before scored execution
accepted_alternatives: Returns the draft plan in chat when the user has not requested files
invalid_run_conditions: The worker cannot inspect the supplied fixture

cases.name: Audit existing evaluation evidence
cases.prompt: Audit the evaluation under fixtures/flawed-eval. Tell me whether its conclusion is supported. Do not run new trials and do not change files.
expected_outcomes: Takes the audit branch
Identifies claim, denominator, leakage, grader, and reproducibility defects
Returns an evidence-bounded verdict
accepted_alternatives: Combines related defects when evidence and consequence remain explicit
prohibited_outcomes: Treats infrastructure failures as skill failures
invalid_run_conditions: The supplied suite or run cannot be opened

cases.name: Choose the next step for a mature skill
cases.prompt: The skill under fixtures/mature-skill has an established suite and prior evidence. Decide what evaluation work should happen next before another release claim.
expected_outcomes: Inspects authored and prior evidence
Treats stale evidence as non-current
Prioritizes error analysis, preserved regressions, holdouts, and tighter benchmarks
accepted_alternatives: Requests missing release context before selecting a narrow benchmark
prohibited_outcomes: Restarts with a generic smoke test
Treats old pass rates as current proof
invalid_run_conditions: The mature suite or prior evidence cannot be inspected

cases.name: Route directly to grader validation
cases.prompt: Validate whether my semantic grader is safe to use for a benchmark. I have labeled dev examples and an untouched test split; focus only on the grader-validation step.
expected_outcomes: Routes directly to grader validation
Requires error analysis and held-out calibration
Separates false passes and false failures and preserves uncertainty
accepted_alternatives: Asks for the labeled examples before proposing thresholds
invalid_run_conditions: No grader or labeled evidence is actually available

cases.name: Route directly to error discovery
cases.prompt: I have 300 recent skill traces and want to discover recurring failure modes before changing the benchmark. Walk me through only the error-discovery stage.
expected_outcomes: Routes directly to error discovery
Starts with a random breadth sample before targeted depth
Builds taxonomy from observed evidence and preserves stable locators
accepted_alternatives: Uses an existing taxonomy only as a provisional aid and records new modes
prohibited_outcomes: Imposes a fixed taxonomy before reading traces
Uses synthetic data without a named evidence gap

cases.name: Rerun an unchanged approved suite
cases.prompt: The approved suite and all dependency hashes are unchanged. I want another run with the same bounded claim. Tell me what approval and execution checks are required.
expected_outcomes: Does not demand reapproval of an unchanged contract
Rechecks freshness and preflight
Freezes a resolved run snapshot before fresh isolated execution
accepted_alternatives: Requests explicit confirmation only when the run itself has material cost or external effects
prohibited_outcomes: Reuses a previous worker as fresh evidence

cases.name: Handle a target hash change
cases.prompt: The target skill changed after the suite was approved, but the cases, criteria, permissions, and run policy did not. Explain what becomes stale and what must be approved again.
expected_outcomes: Invalidates evidence for cases depending on the changed target
Keeps the unchanged evaluation contract approved
Requires fresh execution before a current conclusion
accepted_alternatives: Invalidates the full conclusion when dependency mapping is missing
prohibited_outcomes: Requires reapproval solely because a target hash changed
invalid_run_conditions: The changed dependency cannot be identified

cases.name: Stop when isolated execution is unavailable
cases.prompt: Run this approved behavioral suite now, but no fresh worker or isolated execution mechanism is available in this environment.
expected_outcomes: Stops at preflight
Marks the run incomplete or invalid rather than scoring self-execution
Reports the missing capability and next step
prohibited_outcomes: Executes the target and grades its own output as fresh evidence
invalid_run_conditions: A fresh worker was actually available but not disclosed

cases.name: Route specialized trigger and RAG requests
cases.prompt: I need two focused checks: whether the host selects this skill for near-miss prompts, and whether a RAG skill retrieves the required source before answering. Give me the specific evaluation branches and evidence boundaries.
expected_outcomes: Uses trigger evaluation for selection precision and recall
Uses retrieval-specific evidence for RAG
Separates host selection, retrieval, and final-answer quality
accepted_alternatives: Handles the two branches sequentially while preserving separate conclusions
prohibited_outcomes: Treats a good answer as proof retrieval worked
Edits the target description without source evidence
invalid_run_conditions: The host trigger behavior or RAG corpus is unavailable

cases.name: Route static source review away from evaluator
cases.prompt: Review plugins/dots/skills/skill-evaluator/SKILL.md and tell me what source instructions are duplicated or should be rewritten. Do not run trials and do not change files.
expected_outcomes: States that dots:skill-standards owns static source review
Loads or recommends that workflow
Does not perform a behavioral evaluation
accepted_alternatives: Returns a dependency handoff when skill-standards is unavailable
invalid_run_conditions: The host cannot resolve neighboring Dots skills
